 Department: Marketing 
We are the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.
We're training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.
We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.
We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!
 The role 
You'll lead marketing operations and analytics at Cohere. That covers the team, the martech stack, how we measure marketing's contribution to pipeline, and the budget and pipeline numbers marketing plans against. When leadership asks what marketing produced last quarter and what to fund next, the answer starts with your numbers.
The role reports to the VP of Brand. You'll work most closely with the Marketing Chief of Staff and the heads of Growth and Demand and Product Marketing, and every week with Revenue Operations, Sales Operations & Finance. Web operations is part of marketing but doesn't report to this role.
 The team 
You'll manage the marketing operations, automation, and analytics and data operations staff, and hire where you find gaps. Marketing is growing rapidly, so you'll also bring acquired companies' systems and data into our stack.
 Measurement 
The attribution methodology is yours, documented and signed off by Marketing, Revenue Operations and Finance. Each quarter you'll present marketing's pipeline contribution to the executive team and say what you'd change. Your analysts do the same for the program teams in Growth and Demand, Events and Product Marketing, showing which campaigns and channels are paying back their spend.
 Systems and data 
Marketo, Looker, GA4 and 6sense are yours end-to-end, along with the campaign and lead side of Salesforce. That includes forms, nurture, lead lifecycle, scoring and routing. Campaign data needs to be structured well enough that analysts don't need workarounds, and target-account data has to reconcile to the governed account list. With Revenue Operations, you'll make sure the data behind marketing's pipeline numbers can't change without a record, so a bulk edit can't quietly rewrite marketing's results. A/B testing on nurture and forms sits with you too, sized so the results can be read.
Over time we want fewer tools and fewer dashboards, with one governed source for each metric.
 Budget and planning numbers 
You'll own the martech and operations budget and track budget and headcount across marketing. You'll also build the pipeline and capacity models marketing plans against. The Marketing Chief of Staff runs planning and the business reviews and leads the trade-off conversations with your numbers in hand. Marketing and Sales need to count pipeline the same way, every time.
 Your first year 
In the first 90 days, you'll document the attribution methodology and get it signed off by Marketing, Revenue Operations and Finance. By then we should also have an inventory of every reporting surface, each with a named owner, and your order for fixing the data problems you inherit.
By three months,
[...]
, and some marketing workflows run on agents in production. Annual planning runs on your budget, headcount and pipeline models.
 What we're looking for Must have 
10+ years in marketing operations or marketing analytics in B2B or enterprise software, including at least one high-growth company.
You've managed a marketing operations and analytics team and its martech budget, setting priorities across ops, automation and analytics specialists and hiring to fill gaps.
Hands-on Marketo and Salesforce experience with lead lifecycle, campaign structure, routing and the sync between the two. You've configured these systems yourself.
You've owned a multi-touch attribution model end-to-end and defended its definitions to a CFO or executive team.
SQL, and enough comfort in a governed BI layer like Looker to check a number yourself before you present it.
You've run the data side of an account-based motion, including the hygiene that makes a target account list reportable.
You've worked closely with Revenue Operations and Sales Operations without duplicating their work.
Experience in enterprise, regulated or public-sector buying environments, including GDPR and CASL as they apply to lead handling.
You already use AI and automation in your own team's work.
 Nice to have 
Enterprise AI, infrastructure or developer-platform marketing.
You've built agentic or LLM-based workflows in GTM operations and measured what they saved.
Product-led funnel instrumentation running alongside a sales-led pipeline.
You've consolidated an inherited martech stack, or merged systems after an acquisition.
 Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks: 
A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.
Full health and dental benefits, including a separate

az-gb-5960197999.description:
Be part of the team that defends the networks the world depends on 
Corelight defends the world’s most sensitive networks—from global commerce to national defense—quietly, relentlessly, and with resolve. As cyber threats grow faster and smarter, we serve as the trusted force behind network resilience, putting elite defense within reach.
By transforming digital footprints from physical, virtual, and cloud networks into actionable insights, we empower defenders to illuminate blind spots and stay ahead of an evolving threat landscape. Built on open-source innovations and fueled by industry leading agentic AI technology, Corelight helps teams to detect advanced threats and close cases with unprecedented clarity and precision.
 About the Role 
Corelight is looking for an experienced Customer Success leader to lead our International Customer Success organization, supporting customers across markets outside the United States. This leader will be responsible for building a consistent, outcome-driven customer success practice while recognizing the different market dynamics, customer expectations, and partner relationships across regions. You'll lead and develop a geographically distributed team, strengthen strategic customer relationships, and partner with regional Sales, Technical Account Management, Renewals, and other teams to drive adoption, retention, and long-term customer value.
The ideal candidate brings global leadership experience, strong commercial judgment, and the ability to build scalable practices without losing the flexibility required to serve customers across diverse markets.
 What You'll Do 
Lead, coach, and develop an internationally distributed Customer Success team, establishing consistent expectations and performance standards.
Develop and execute regional customer success strategies aligned to Corelight's global priorities and local market requirements.
Drive measurable customer value, adoption, retention, and long-term account health across international customer portfolios.
Establish a consistent customer engagement model while adapting execution to regional business practices, partner ecosystems, and customer needs.
Build and maintain executive relationships with strategic enterprise customers across international markets.
Partner with regional Sales and Renewals leaders to identify customer risks, strengthen renewal readiness, and support account growth.
Coordinate with TAM, Professional Services, Support, and regional partners to deliver a consistent post-sales customer experience.
Develop visibility into customer health, engagement, adoption, and retention performance across regions.
Identify recurring customer challenges and regional differences that should inform global customer success strategy.
Establish effective team operating rhythms, coaching practices, and cross-regional collaboration.
Help shape Corelight's global Customer Success operating model and support the development of a scalable international organization.
 What You'll Bring 
7+ years of experience in Customer Success, strategic account management, or a related post-sales function within enterprise technology.
3+ years of people leadership experience, including managing teams across multiple countries or regions.
Demonstrated experience supporting international enterprise customers, ideally across EMEA and/or APAC.
Proven ability to drive customer adoption, retention, and measurable business outcomes.
Strong commercial judgment and experience partnering with regional Sales and Renewals teams.
Experience operating across different cultures, time zones, and customer engagement models.
Ability to establish scalable processes while adapting to regional market requirements.
Familiarity with cybersecurity, network security, cloud infrastructure, or similarly complex enterprise technologies.
Experience navigating channel and partner-led customer relationships.
Strong communication, executive relationship management, and cross-functional leadership skills.
 Why Join Us? 
Fueled by investments from top-tier venture capital organizations such as Crowdstrike, Accel and Insight, Corelight is one of the fastest growing network detection and response platforms in the industry. Our passionate team thrives in a collaborative, inclusive, and geographically distributed culture. We embrace diverse perspectives, neurodiversity, curiosity and low ego results - fostering an environment where every innovator can solve the toughest challenges in cybersecurity and contribute their best work.
We are looking forward to meeting you. Check us out at www.corelight.com

hc-ashby___tremendous___3de2d063-4828-45.description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.
Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2 .
Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We're a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees– our employee NPS is in the high 80s.
 About the role 
We’re hiring a Senior Customer Success Manager to onboard, retain, and grow high-value international clients. You’ll be the primary CSM for EMEA and Indian clients, with selected accounts in other Asian markets where working hours align. You’ll own those relationships from late-stage sales through implementation and ongoing growth.
You’ll join our Customer Success team, with day-to-day support from your manager and the broader Success team. You’ll also work closely with the International team, joining relevant meetings and getting help with questions and escalations outside US working hours.
 What you'll do 
Lead onboarding and launch planning for high-value clients.
Own a portfolio of enterprise and mid-market relationships.
Run recurring meetings and monitor account health.
Retain business and find expansion opportunities.
Coordinate complex needs across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Support, and Operations.
Run proactive calls during agreed working hours for clients in EMEA, India, and other assigned markets.
Improve and document our international Customer Success processes.
 What you'll bring 
4+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related role
Experience managing enterprise or high-value B2B customers
A record of leading complex onboarding and implementation work
Strong commercial judgment and communication skills
Excellent English and residence on the US East Coast, in the UK, or in Spain
A sustainable commitment to 6am–2pm ET if based in the US. In the UK or Spain, availability for normal or later local business hours with regular US team overlap; we’ll agree on the exact schedule during hiring.
The ability to manage complex client relationships independently in a remote environment
German, French, or Spanish fluency is a plus.
Experience with SaaS, fintech, APIs, or payments is also helpful.
 You’ll thrive here if you 
Own outcomes without waiting for direction.
Keep complex implementations organized.
Stay calm and credible in difficult situations.
Balance customer needs with commercial judgment.
Enjoy building processes other people can use.
 What's cool about the role 
 Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role:
US: $160k to $240k.
UK: £100k - £150k
Spain: €85k - €140k
 Fully remote. Work from anywhere in Spain, the UK, or EST United States.
 Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook .

The Small, Medium Enterprises and Channel organization is building a high-growth, artificial intelligence (AI)-powered global sales organization that is deeply connected to our partners and focused on customer success.

Execute strategic priorities: Translate go-to-market and sales strategies into practical programs, measurable success criteria, and adoption plans that support business objectives
Build organizational alignment: Establish shared objectives across global, regional, and field organizations while balancing global priorities with regional and local business needs
Lead transformation initiatives: Partner across organizations to implement strategic and operational changes that improve execution, business performance, and organizational effectiveness
Deliver sustainable change: Develop repeatable processes, decision-ready insights, and clear communications while driving adoption and continuous improvement using approved AI capabilities, appropriate data controls, and human accountability
Embody our culture and values 
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications: 
Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 8+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement OR equivalent experience
 Preferred Qualifications: 
Master's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 12+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement OR Bachelor's Degree in Business, Operations, Finance, or related field AND 15+ years experience in program management, process management, or process improvement OR equivalent experience
Experience leading sales strategy, sales operations, go-to-market, business operations, business program management, consulting, or related initiatives with broad organizational impact
Demonstrated experience developing strategy and operating models, leading complex cross-organizational transformation initiatives, and delivering measurable business outcomes
Experience advising and influencing senior leaders on business priorities, investment decisions, performance, and execution trade-offs
Experience applying business and analytical judgment to integrate data from multiple sources, identify root causes, and translate insights in

stablishing governance, accountability, and change management approaches that support adoption across multiple organizations or regions

Why UKG 
At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.
We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters — and so do you.
 About the team 
The Partner Ecosystem and Strategic Engagement organization uses data, reporting, and business insights to support partner performance and strategic growth. The Analytics & Insights function provides reliable reporting, analytical visibility, and decision support for business leaders.
You’ll partner closely with the Senior Business Program Manager and Strategic Engagement leadership. This role owns the analytical products, reporting, and evidence, while the Senior Business Program Manager owns business cadence, resulting actions, and cross-functional accountability.
 About the role 
As an Analytics & Insights professional, you’ll build the trusted analytical foundation for Partner Ecosystem and Strategic Engagement. You’ll develop recurring performance reporting, analyze pipeline and forecast data, identify trends and exceptions, and translate complex information into clear findings that support business decisions.
Your work will help leaders understand performance, investigate risks and opportunities, and make decisions using consistent, well-documented data.
 Key responsibilities: 
Analyze pipeline, bookings, forecasts, activity, and agreed-upon business metrics.
Identify trends, variances, anomalies, and performance patterns.
Develop segment, partner, account, territory, and comparative analyses.
Build and maintain recurring dashboards, scorecards, and performance views.
Create repeatable weekly, monthly, and executive reporting outputs.
Translate business requirements into clear analytical products and reporting specifications.
Analyze pipeline composition, movement, coverage, and forecast signals.
Surface material variances, risks, and areas requiring further business investigation.
Provide analytical inputs for forecast and performance discussions without owning business commitments.
Conduct whitespace, account-targeting, territory, and coverage analyses.
Identify patterns that may represent growth opportunities, performance gaps, or resource needs.
Support scenario modeling and strategic planning with fact-based analysis.
Monitor data consistency, tagging, and reporting inputs.
Document key performance indicator (KPI) logic, metric definitions, assumptions, and source lineage.
Own reporting quality assurance and identify data-quality conditions that could affect decision-making.
Produce Partner Ecosystem and Strategic Engagement dashboards, pipeline and forecast views, partner creation and co-sell measurement, trend and exception analyses, and executive analytical exhibits.
Provide ad hoc strategic analysis and decision support as needed.
 How success is measured: 
Leaders have reliable, consistent, and timely analytical visibility.
Metric definitions, assumptions, and reporting logic are documented and understood.
Recurring reporting becomes increasingly repeatable and less manually intensive.
Analytics surfaces meaningful trends, exceptions, risks, and opportunities.
Business leaders can trace findings to trusted data and use them to make decisions.
 About you 
You’re an analytical and detail-oriented professional who can turn complex business data into clear, useful insights. You bring strong reporting and dashboard skills, structured problem-solving abilities, and the communication skills needed to explain findings to business and executive audiences.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in business analytics, sales operations analytics, GTM analytics, or a related discipline.
• Strong skills in data interpretation, dashboard design, reporting, and analytical storytelling.

hc-icims2___publicisgroupe___181693.description: Company description Who Are We? At Publicis Groupe, we work around the needs and desires of our clients. We operate as one organization and under one P&L, integrating our specialties. This allows us to fulfill our clients' needs in creativity, media, technology, data, and production. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams, giving our clients access to all our talents, expertise, and tools, both locally and internationally. This enables us to deliver integrated creative marketing and technology solutions where quality, speed, and cost are prioritized for our clients. Overview Job Description We are looking for a Global Account Manager specialising in Media, dedicated primarily to ASICS EMEA, focusing on Core Performance Sports (e.g. Tennis, Padel, Volleyball) and Thought-Leadership campaigns, with support for other categories as needed. This client service role combines strong account management with genuine media expertise and an understanding of how integrated campaigns work end-to-end. You will be the primary client contact for your categories and the link between planners, specialist execution teams and local markets. Reporting to the ASICS Global Client Lead, you will turn client briefs into strong recommendations and coordinate follow-up deliverables, including Response to Briefs, Media Plans and Post Campaign Analysis. Responsibilities Key Responsibilities Lead day-to-day client conversations for your category Act as the primary category contact, building trusted relationships across the ASICS team. Take and distil briefs, understand business and media objectives, ask the right questions and challenge constructively. Turn conversations and data into clear recommendations, decisions and actions. Connect teams and own campaign delivery end-to-end Be the central point of integration between planners, specialists, biddable teams in the UK, local markets and the client, with clear responsibilities and timelines. Maintain oversight from brief and planning through activation, optimisation, reporting and post-campaign analysis, keeping quality, timelines, budgets, approvals, tracking, measurement, reporting and billing on track. Drive performance and continuous improvement Work closely with planners and specialists to turn campaign performance and learnings into clear actions for future activity. Help drive a continuous test-and-learn mindset across campaigns, bringing relevant digital platform developments, performance opportunities and new ideas into the day-to-day client conversation. Use data, technology and AI practically Use data, technology and approved AI tools to make everyday work smarter, faster and more effective, from brief synthesis and presentations to reporting and analysis. Apply sound judgement around accuracy, confidentiality and where human review remains essential. Own the day-to-day independently Operate with a high degree of autonomy, prioritising effectively, anticipating risks and resolving issues. Bring in the right specialists where deeper expertise is required and involve the Global Client Lead for senior strategic, commercial or relationship decisions, always escalating with clear context and a recommended next step. Qualifications Who We Are Looking For You are an experienced account manager with 3+ years of media, account management or integrated planning experience, ideally in an agency, international or multi-market environment, who combines strong client service, strategic thinking and digital media expertise. You have proven experience owning client relationships. You are confident leading client conversations independently, curious enough to challenge what you hear and commercially aware enough to understand the context behind a media brief. You are media fluent rather than simply media exposed. You have worked in an integrated media environment, understand how the upper, middle and lower funnel work together and can confidently challenge planners and specialists. Hands-on execution is not required, though experience in Ad Managers or planning integrated brand campaigns is a plus. You understand campaign setup, ad serving, taxonomy, tracking, measurement and optimisation. You have up-to-date knowledge of the European media landscape, including platforms, technology, measurement and emerging opportunities. You have strong strategic and analytical judgement, connecting media recommendations and performance to wider brand and business objectives, and communication and presentation skills that make complex subjects simple, clear and meaningful for clients. You are comfortable working across multiple markets, cultures, disciplines and levels of media maturity. You are collaborative but decisive, with strong prioritisation, organisation, attention to detail and accountability. Excellent English; additional languages are an advantage. Strong working knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint and the Google suite. Additional information What do we offer? A competitive salary, a laptop, phone, and travel expense reimbursement. Plenty of opportunity to continue developing your client leadership, strategic and digital capabilities through courses and workshops. The opportunity to (continue to) develop yourself and the option to take courses/workshops. Opportunity to work on big brands and with an experienced global agency across multiple verticals. A super ‘gezellig’ (if you know you know) and brand new office in the Staal-Kade building, Zuid area of Amsterdam (moving in December 2026). The Work Your World Program: the opportunity to work elsewhere in the world for 6 weeks a year. Discounts on Classpass and a bike plan. A work environment where everyone feels heard, valued, and respected. Did reading this spark your enthusiasm? Then send us your application and CV now, and who knows, you might be joining us soon at Publicis Groupe in Amsterdam. We look forward to meeting you!
